name: Shinseiki Ijitte Princess ~Mou! Mata Sonna Koto Made~
original_name: 新世紀いじってプリンセス～もう！またそんなことまで～
source:
Sin travels around with a maid, Lina, for the ruins of the Supple Kingdom. He finally finds it, and goes inside. A vision of the king suddenly appears in front of him, and tells him that Sin is a direct descendant of the king. The king also asks him to revive the kingdom. At first, he needs to find his wife.... Will he be able to take the first step for the revival of the Supple Kingdom?

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20081030015012/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1007885]ErogeShop.com[/url]]
translation:
辛与女仆莉娜四处旅行，寻找萨普尔王国的遗迹。他终于找到遗迹并走了进去。国王的幻影突然出现在他面前，告诉辛，他正是国王的直系后裔。国王还请求他复兴王国。而首先要做的，就是找到自己的妻子……他能够为萨普尔王国的复兴迈出第一步吗？
